# Emotion Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EmotionType`](gmeow-EmotionType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EmotionType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

The kind of an emotion — an OPEN value vocabulary seeded with Plutchik's primary eight (the EmotionML standard set). Registry-independent and contestable, never a tree (the [`Genre`](gmeow-Genre.md)/Register precedent): traditions disagree about the emotion inventory itself, and that disagreement is data, not error ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EmotionType`](gmeow-EmotionType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
